0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, on a one-game win streak, 8th in the West and 1.5 games back of the 2nd spot in the Pacific) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, on a three-game win streak, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, with the last meeting coming on April 27, 2026 in Phoenix, where the Suns lost 131-122. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (day-to-day, oblique strain, a game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber (all out, with surgeries to the back, Achilles and knee), and Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and Jaylin Williams are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
